name: Malaysia
sources: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265), as amended by Act A1651 (2022)
Employer's Mandatory Commitment on foreign worker levy (2018)

rules.match_hint: employer, agent or company keeps, holds or stores the worker's passport
rules.why: It is an offence for an employer to withhold your passport.
rules.action: Keep your passport yourself. If it was taken, report it to the Labour Department or the police.

rules.why: The minimum wage is RM1,700 a month, and it applies to foreign workers too.
rules.action: Do not accept a salary below the minimum wage. Report it to the Labour Department.

rules.match_hint: foreign worker levy deducted from or paid by the worker
rules.why: Since 2018 the employer must pay the foreign worker levy. It is not a lawful deduction from your wage.
rules.source: Employer's Mandatory Commitment (2018); Employment Act s. 24(1)
rules.action: Ask for the levy deduction to be removed and refunded.

rules.match_hint: deductions for housing, food, recruitment costs, fines, or deductions above half the wage
rules.why: Only deductions allowed by the Employment Act are legal. Housing and food can only be deducted if you asked in writing and the Labour Department approved it, and all deductions together cannot exceed 50% of your monthly wage.
rules.action: Do not sign a request for deductions you don't want. Check each payslip.

rules.match_hint: more than 8 hours a day or 45 hours a week of normal working time
rules.why: Normal working time is capped at 8 hours a day and 45 hours a week, with a break of at least 30 minutes every 5 hours.
rules.source: Employment Act s. 60A(1), as amended in 2022
rules.action: Make sure extra hours are recorded and paid as overtime.

rules.match_hint: overtime unpaid, included in salary, or paid at the normal rate
rules.why: Overtime must be paid at least 1.5 times your hourly rate (for workers earning RM4,000 a month or less).
rules.action: Ask for the overtime rate in writing. Keep a daily record of your hours.

rules.match_hint: work 7 days a week, no weekly rest day
rules.why: You must get one whole rest day each week, and you cannot be forced to work on it except in emergencies.
rules.action: Ask for a fixed weekly rest day in the contract.

rules.match_hint: less than 8 days annual leave, or no annual leave
rules.why: You get at least 8 days of paid annual leave a year (12 after 2 years, 16 after 5 years).
rules.action: Ask for the leave clause to match the law.

rules.match_hint: worker must pay recruitment costs, a fine or penalty for resigning or leaving early
rules.why: Recruitment costs should not be charged to workers, and making you pay to be allowed to leave can count as forced labour, which is now an offence under the Employment Act.
rules.source: Employment Act (forced labour provision, 2022 amendment); ILO fair recruitment principles
rules.action: Do not sign this clause. Report threats or penalties to the Labour Department.
